description:
Beadwork **CLI** copy only: aliases, help, completions, command-facing strings.

## Background

Aliases still say “Run a bounded epic loop”. Completions still offer workers/until/noSpawn.

## Owns

- `command-aliases.ts`
- `command-completions.ts` for `/bw run` (epic id only; reject supervisor flags)
- command help strings in those CLI files

## Does not own

- `/bw abandon` command or its completions — **2.6** entirely.
- TUI tabs/statusline — **2.5**.
- Package READMEs, operator guides, migration docs — **4.4**.
- No placeholder/TODO for abandon.

## Success criteria

- `/bw run` help and completions are epic-only.
- No “bounded epic loop” in CLI copy.

## Test plan

- Completions values for run; rejected flags.
- Grep command descriptions for tmux/workers/bounded epic loop.

## Considerations

If `/bw run` argv changes land in 2.3, this issue follows 2.3. Do not wait on 2.6.
title: Update Beadwork CLI help, completions, and in-tree worker docs
